items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: Well, the time I was playing at them, they had Kid Renee, Edna Mitchell, Joe Renee, myself, Manny Gabriel... Andy. Andy. Andy. Henry Hardin.

ctx.x: Who was in that band at that time?

Well, the time I was playing at them, they had Kid Renee, Edna Mitchell, Joe Renee, myself, Manny Gabriel, what's this boy, what you say, boy, he put up there with you all? Andy. Andy. Andy. Henry Hardin.

items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, Sonny Henry maybe. Sonny Henry we had. Yeah, we had Sonny Henry playing.

ctx.x: We had Ray, Trimone, Trimone and his boy Trimone and Tillman played.
Oh, Sonny Henry maybe. Sonny Henry we had. Yeah, we had Sonny Henry playing. And we had a baritone player.

His brother they called, he made up that band. His brother made up that Arrica band. He played. One of the fellow Wilson. Wilson, that's it. His brother played the baritone. I can't call his name. I never knew it. But he played baritone in the band. They didn't use no peck horn. They always go saxophone to play. How to build an Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland
